operation: Curated presheaf-like factorization with an executable finite constraint presheaf and a separate fixed-artifact availability copresheaf.

roles.presheaf_paper_ports: Extracted scoped categorical ports and proposed bridge requirements from pinned existing paper readings, without using score thresholds.
roles.presheaf_math_audit: Audited the mathematical construction and code; found malformed-cover and partial-local-section pitfalls.
roles.presheaf_interface: Built the interactive view; no scientific predicate selection.
roles.root: Constructed finite predicates and engine, refined source projection, implemented regressions, exported and published.

independence: Separate contexts share the same inherited model family. No external expert calibration, theorem-prover certification or independent scientific reproduction.
interpretation: Ports and predicates are explicit lossy modeling choices, not discovered universal laws. Passing records meet the stated screen only.
execution: Actual deterministic identity/composition, restriction closure, availability and gluing fixtures plus48actual-packet scenarios. No new scientific experiments, data reanalysis, learned sheaf or cohomology.
